dialogueEntries.text: A hidden book on the bottom catches your eye. Your dad used to read this to you when you were younger.
Read it?
Read it?
Once upon a time, there was a young bunny. She grew up her whole life in the burrow.
Her parents, out of concern for her safety, never let her explore the outside. But this bunny's curiosity could not be contained.
She wanted to live, not just survive. So one night, she snuck out of the burrow, and explored.
She saw beautiful sights. She felt the warm sun on her fur, and found friends who didn't look like her.
But the bunny wanted more. She wanted to live. So, she set her sights on climbing a grand mountain.
'No animal could do it, especially not a bunny' they said. But this only made her want to try more.
On the way, she encountered many obstacles. Foxes who hunted her down. Thunderstorms that stole the tranquility of the night. Steep hills leaving her tiny feet exhausted.
Soon enough, she realized she couldn't make it. Not alone, and not with her inexperience.
Depressed, she descended the mountain. A tortoise found her wallowing by the river.
'Why do you need to do this?' he'd said.
'To make my life significant. To live. Truly live.' the bunny replied.
'Who said living had to be grand? Everything you've done up to this point was living. Every laugh, every safe night underground, every struggle.'
'To live is to simply experience what is around you. To take every moment and profit from it.'
'But the mountain,' the bunny replied. 'I want to scale it.'
'The mountain will be there for you when you're ready. For now, just live.' the tortoise advised.
So live the bunny did. She went home, and grew up a little more. Then, she explored again, reaching new sights.
And one day, she still pledged to scale the mountain. But that was later, and this was now.
Now, her task was to just live.
